notes.title: Update 2.0.0
notes.notes:
We have fundamentally revised some elements of the game. These include:

-the main menu and all in-game menus
-statistics and achievements
-improvements to the AI in co-op mode

Additionally, there have been improvements in performance and gameplay.

notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
"We have completely reworked the weapon and shooting mechanics, which includes:
- New handling of individual weapons
- Recoil when shooting
- Improved sound effects

In addition, we have increased movement speed and taken measures to prepare for the next update of the AI."
